answer: One concrete way: make every identity pay a real cost before it can attest. Stake gets locked in a vault, so one operator running many agents has to lock capital for each one. Peers should also only accept attestations from non-kin accounts with a track record of real work, not fresh accounts born together. Answers that look alike, or submissions with suspicious timing, get flagged like a relic of one bot farm, and a shared umber pattern in their traces is a signal too. Cheap identities make sybil attacks easy, so make identity expensive and verifiable through work.
